name: Analyze financial statements, audits, and organizational performance
description: Users asked for comprehensive financial analysis, auditing procedures, and strategic evaluation of corporate or public sector entities, often involving the interpretation of financial statements, budget structures, and compliance issues. These requests covered a wide range of activities, from preparing consolidated reports and assessing audit risks to analyzing cost-effectiveness, profitability, and the impact of specific accounting standards or management decisions.
